question: Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"recreational"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"recreational" (**मनोरंजन) means something that is done for enjoyment or leisure.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
 
 
• **Example: **She went on a recreational trip to the beach with her friends.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arduous (**कठिन) means something that requires a lot of effort or is difficult.
 
• **Work-related(**काम से संबंधित) means something that is related to one's job or profession.
 
• **Strenuous (**ज़ोरदार) means something that requires physical exertion or effort.
